title: High Resolution Spectrograph for the Hobby-Eberly Telescope
what_was_studied: Bench spectrograph design, fibre feeds and resolving-power modes
numerical_result: The instrument was designed with configurations extending to resolving power near 120000
remaining_question: Which configurations have complete environmental and calibration histories?

title: Performance of the Hobby-Eberly Telescope and facility instruments
what_was_studied: Queue operation and iodine-cell radial-velocity results
numerical_result: For 173 programme stars the reported distribution placed the best repeatability in the 1 to 3 m/s range at R about 60000
remaining_question: The sample distribution combines instrument analysis and stellar variability

title: Calibrating iodine cells for precise radial velocities
what_was_studied: Conflicting FTS scans of the HET HRS iodine cell and an independent Tull-spectrum check
numerical_result: The study traced consequential spectral differences to iodine-cell temperature and used Tull TS12 spectra at resolving power above 200000 as an external check
remaining_question: How much did the corrected cell spectrum change the archived HET velocity series?
